feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 1 October 2026 11:49am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 01 October 2026 at 11:40am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure near Iceland will bring fronts overnight and through tomorrow.


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6 this evening, then becoming south or southwest 5 or 6 overnight. Perhaps occasionally increasing 7 in the east of the area tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate this evening.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain spreads from the west overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 5 or 6, occasionally 7 tomorrow afternoon and early evening. Veering and decreasing west or northwest 4 or 5 late evening or early in the night, then further decreasing 3 or 4 late in the night into Saturday.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, becoming moderate or rough through the afternoon and early evening, then gradually falling slight by the end of the night.


##Weather##

Spells of rain, becoming fair overnight into Saturday.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in rain at first.
